Unit 3 · SCAMPER Technique for Innovation · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.3, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: Change the Chai. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: SCAMPER is not inspiration. It is seven questions asked in order, and it works even on a day when you feel like you have no ideas.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, Rearrange.
Running all seven badly beats running two well — the value is in coverage.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.lead: Eliminate is the most productive and the least used
block_data.body: People add. Removing is where the surprises are.
Fill all seven rows first. Evaluate afterwards, never during.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Run all seven prompts on a physical object in this room, then on one you chose.

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
